Do you want to make an impact at leading enterprise clients in the field of Cloud technology?
 As a Cloud Engineer , you help clients accelerate their digital transformation by designing, implementing, and optimizing cloud solutions. You switch easily between strategic thinking and operational execution, and work closely with Itility's Managing Consultants and Cloud Engineers. Does this energize you? Then we are looking for you!
Recently, in order to facilitate our increasing number of customers, we have decided to expand our operation and open a tech office in Iasi, Romania. So if you are a Cloud enthusiast with a desire to work in a team of highly skilled professionals, while delivering value to our customers, Itility might just be the place for you.
 Your role
 You already have a few years of experience as a cloud engineer, systems engineer, or infrastructure specialist and are ready for the next step: broadening your skills. At Itility, you get that opportunity. You enjoy designing, building, and managing secure, scalable, and reliable cloud environments that deliver immediate value for our clients. You are proficient with public cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud and have experience with Infrastructure as Code, automation, and modern DevOps practices. You enjoy working across different technologies and continuously expanding your knowledge of cloud-native solutions, container platforms, and automation tools.
 What You Are Going To Do
 You work in a team of passionate professionals on designing, implementing, and improving Cloud environments. Together with your fellow consultants, you work on innovative projects for major clients in diverse sectors.
Your duties include, among others:
Analyzing customer challenges and translating them into practical cloud solutions
Designing and implementing Cloud architectures (for example in Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud)
Automating infrastructure and application management using IaC tools and CI/CD pipelines
Improving existing Cloud environments in terms of costs, security, performance, and manageability
Coaching clients and colleagues in the use of Cloud technology and DevOps practices
Building a sustainable customer relationship and identifying new opportunities
 This is what we offer
You will have the opportunity to develop yourself to your full potential, under the personal guidance of the rest of the team. In addition to a competitive salary, you will receive extras such as:
26 vacation days
Meal vouchers
Performance bonus opportunity appliable twice a year
Private health insurance
Private pension option
Itility Academy - hard & soft skills training
Hybrid working
 This is you
You are someone who enjoys taking responsibility, switches gears quickly, and always seeks the best solution. You know how to bridge the gap between technology and business and are capable of clearly communicating complex topics. Additionally, you possess:
A bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, mathematics, or electrical engineering
More than 3 years of experience as a Cloud consultant or engineer in an enterprise or consultancy environment
In-depth knowledge of at least two Cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud)
Experience with topics such as Cloud cost control, security, networking, and monitoring
Skills in scripting/automation (e.g. Terraform, ARM, Bicep, Python or PowerShell)
Strong communication skills and a result-oriented mindset
